lines.text: Inside your body stands a super-strong architectural frame: two hundred and six bones!
They protect your brain, shield your heart, and let you jump eight feet high!
Every time you drink milk or eat yogurt, you swallow billions of calcium minerals!
Special construction cells called osteoblasts grab calcium right out of your blood!
They lay down tough collagen rebar, then cement it with hard mineral crystals!
Running, jumping rope, and playing outside tells your bones, Make us stronger!
And sunshine gives you Vitamin D, the magic key that unlocks calcium absorption!
Build your skeleton fortress today so you can run fast and jump high forever!
Fuel your growing body—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
